program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((s1 (normalize-cells (find-color g 1)))
         (s2 (normalize-cells (find-color g 2)))
         (s3 (normalize-cells (find-color g 3)))
         (union (remove-duplicates (append s1 s2 s3)))
         (exact2 (filter (lambda (p)
                           (= (+ (if (member? p s1) 1 0)
                                 (if (member? p s2) 1 0)
                                 (if (member? p s3) 1 0))
                              2))
                         union)))
    (if (empty? exact2)
        (empty-grid 1 1 0)
        (let* ((norm (normalize-cells exact2))
               (h (+ 1 (apply max (map first norm))))
               (w (+ 1 (apply max (map second norm)))))
          (grid-from-fn h w
            (lambda (r c) (if (member? (list r c) norm) 8 0)))))))
